description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Quantum Misalignment (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Selesnya Sanctuary onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Selesnya Sanctuary trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
